development-full-method.sampling: First79 earliest broad-query submissions captured in one official page; ten GS medical/sensor seeds; eight adjacent reconstruction seeds; three exact-ID NeRF foundations. No policy output used for packet selection.
development-full-method.scope: 100 source-captured candidate records reviewed by Codex; 82 official arXiv metadata records and 18 legacy seed descriptions. Purposive scope fixture, not independent human adjudication or a population estimate.
development-full-method.scope_definition: Include actual Gaussian primitive splatting/rendering methods and applications across sensors, GS enablers explicitly evaluated on GS, relevant GS surveys, and the three explicitly named NeRF rendering foundations. Exclude statistical Gaussian models and unrelated acronym expansions. Review geometric precursors and adjacent methods whose concrete GS role is not established by available evidence. Seed descriptions remain legacy evidence, not verified author abstracts. This separately versioned review additionally includes Matrix3D, MASt3R and Bayes’ Rays only on the retained, per-record primary source evidence establishing their concrete GS methodological role. Original limited-evidence labels remain preserved; this is not independent or population validation.
